TEXT: The place Kirino brought me to was the shopping mall.
As it was a day off, there were many people crowded together, like vegetables in a stew.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well? What route are we going to take?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: First, we'll go to the shop I should've seen with my friend and pick out a dress for work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah.
Without even waiting for a reply, she plunged headfirst into the shop.
...So, it would've been fine without me, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah... They got a new one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmmm.  The design is good, but the color is kinda... 'Scuse me!  Is this the only color for it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, shut up for a second.
She forced me to come and all she says to me is to shut up?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey, what do you think of this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, nevermind. Let me say this first. It's not your opinion I want, I just want a normal guy's opinion. Don't be mistaken.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I wasn't!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: So? I'm still waiting for your thoughts.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's fine, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...What's with that vague reply?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, even if you ask me, all I can give is a vague answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Tsk... Ah! This is cute too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh... Not even listening...
I'm certain my male brothers of the world would understand my feelings right now.
This feeling of boredom and awkwardness is overwhelming.
I mean, it's strange that I'm at a store for girls.
And yet, if I were to leave this place, I would be forced to listen to her unreasonable abuse.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Phew... And... that's that with this store.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You didn't buy anything in the end. Is that okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah, since I'm getting a feel for the overall image. After this, there's another round to go through it all. Then after that, I plan to go back and decide.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Another round going back...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's for work, so of course!  This isn't something to raise a fuss over.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, before the next store, how about a little tea break?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why are you deciding what to do? It's still too early!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah...
I reluctantly followed after Kirino who walked ahead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: We've gone around more than 5 places already. Are there still more?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: This is absolutely necessary for working as a model.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Necessary for work, huh?  Don't tell me that in this recession, they have you taking care of your own clothes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: They wouldn't do that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, didn't you just say it was absolutely necessary for work?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course, during the photo shoot, it's the stylist that prepares the clothes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But outside of photo shoots, it's not like those are my clothes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's okay to just wear them on those days, but if I wear them every day, during photo shoots I thought I could display them with better appeal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: If I have good sense there, I'll get noticed and I can connect with the next job.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wow, models have it tough, too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course! I'm seen every day! There's no excuse for half-hearted fashion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah! Let's look at this one next!
As she spotted the next store, she went in without paying any more attention to me.
And then she started looking around the store as intensely as before.
She's even gotten used to talking with the sales staff.
Still, it's not that easy for her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *sigh*...
Though I had only accompanied Kirino around for a little while, I had been freely used as a baggage handler.
There were enough bags to hold onto that I quickly became exhausted.
So, because there were so many, I was allowed to wait outside the store, which was an improvement.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Was she planning to buy this much if she came with her friend?
I sat on the bench and thought about this, and unexpectedly I realized...
...If it's her, she would.
Oh, isn't that Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey!  Ayase!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah... Eh?
I had casually called out without thinking, but as Ayase looked at me, she gave me a hesitant expression.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's with that expression?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: B-Because... those bags...
That's right.  I'm carrying bags for Kirino right now.
If she found out I'm on a shopping date with my little sister, it'll be awful!
Because Ayase has some kind of bizarre affection for Kirino...
If the situation were to be exposed, I could honestly say my life... is over.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san, don't tell me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, no!  This is for a female friend...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It's not possible for Onii-san to have such a friend!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The immediate rebuttal?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: A little sister fetish isn't so bad... no, even if you couldn't resist, it's inexcusable!  Don't tell me...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You've sunk to buying every thing related to women's fashion in sight... Imagining Kirino wearing them too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Just how far are you going to go with your delusion?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san... please continue like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... Huh? Huh?! What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: If you drown yourself in this world of fantasy, the real Kirino will be safe.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: So please continue to enjoy your shopping, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?! You're misunderstanding!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It's okay! As long as it's not hurting Kirino, I'll keep it a secret for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Well then, I have to get going. Enjoy your shopping!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey... Ayase! A-ya-se!
Without paying any more attention to my words, Ayase bowed her head and left.
Left alone after that sudden attack had me in a state of incredible shock.
What was that...
In the end, I avoided a nasty argument... right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hm? Why is your face so pale?
Kirino, who had just finished shopping, handed me some new bags.
And, she stared blankly with an unfathomable expression...
